value.headline: Four weeks before Election Day, mail ballot returns are up 30% over same point in 2022
value.claim: 201,909 mail ballots returned, up 30% on the same point in 2022
value.evidence: True for its date [V SOS release text]. The lead faded: at E-14 returns were 789,572 vs 771,967 in 2022, +2.3% [V/V]. Used later as surge evidence it overstates.

value.headline: More than 780,000 Michigan voters have cast their ballot two weeks before Election Day
value.claim: 2.1 million ballots requested, a 17% increase from two weeks before the 2022 midterm
value.evidence: Requests 2,121,458 vs 1,810,569 = +17.2% [M]. The same release shows votes cast 789,572 vs 771,967 = +2.3% [V]; the headline comparison is requests, not ballots.

value.headline: What do Michigan's early voting numbers reveal?

value.evidence: 17% is the request growth. Ballots cast were +2.3% at E-14 [M from SOS releases]. The piece itself cautions early votes do not predict winners.
